findings.current: Blood and phlegm bubbled up through his neatly severed windpipe.
findings.defect: The draft changes a split throat into a neatly severed windpipe.
findings.rationale: The source describes blood and phlegm bubbling through his split throat, not a severed windpipe.
findings.replacement: Blood and phlegm bubbled through the gaping wound in his throat.
findings.source: 쩍 갈라진 목젖 사이로 피가래가 끓는다.

findings.current: Taizu, who had burned his sect to the ground and slaughtered his Master and Senior Brothers, had also become a dead man.
findings.defect: Fellow disciples are omitted from those Taizu slaughtered.
findings.rationale: 사형제들 encompasses his fellow disciples, not only Senior Brothers.
findings.replacement: Taizu, who had burned his sect to the ground and slaughtered his Master and fellow disciples, was dead too.
findings.source: 사문을 불태우고 스승과 사형제들을 도륙했던 태조 역시 불귀의 객이 되었다.

findings.current: “And I will sow no seeds of misfortune. Whatever consequences may return to me, I will bear them and reap what I have sown.”
findings.defect: “Reap what I have sown” implies accepting the results of harmful seeds he planted, rather than accepting whatever consequences follow from his refusal to plant them.
findings.rationale: His pledge is to refrain from causing misfortune even if that choice has consequences for him.
findings.replacement: “And I will sow no seeds of misfortune. Whatever consequences that choice brings, I will bear them and take responsibility for them.”
findings.source: “또한, 그 어떤 불행의 씨앗도 뿌리지 않겠소. 설령 그것이 어떠한 결과로 되돌아온다 해도, 오롯이 감내하고 거둬들이겠소.”

findings.current: The meaning behind the young prince’s final words—the two characters for *forgiveness*—cut into his heart like a blade.
findings.defect: 관용 is mercy or tolerance, not the forgiveness named separately in the surrounding passage.
findings.rationale: The source distinguishes the prince’s merciful pledge from the Demon Lord’s inability to forgive.
findings.replacement: The meaning behind the young prince’s final words—the two characters for *mercy*—cut into his heart like a blade.
findings.source: 어린 왕의 마지막 말에 담긴 의미가, 관용(寬容)이라는 두 글자가 칼날이 되어 그의 마음을 난자했기 때문이었다.

findings.current: The Emperor, Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao, had personally stepped aside to clear the way.
findings.defect: The draft identifies Prince Shangshan as the Emperor, collapsing two people into one.
findings.rationale: 황제가 and 상산왕 주표가 name two separate people who clear Jin Taekyung’s path.
findings.replacement: The Emperor and Prince Shangshan Zhu Bao had personally stepped aside to clear the way.
findings.source: 황제가, 상산왕 주표가 친히 걸음을 옮겨 길을 터 주었으니까.

findings.defect: The prince’s direct conversational prompt becomes a request for permission to ask a question.
findings.rationale: The Korean introduces what he is about to disclose; it does not ask permission.

findings.current:
People who had stepped outside the Great Nation’s laws and built their own shelter.

And yet they had willingly torn down that shelter and rushed into a deadly place full of danger.
findings.defect: “Shelter” turns the martial artists’ self-imposed separation into physical protection, obscuring what they chose to set aside.
findings.rationale: 울타리 is the boundary they established for themselves and then chose to break for others.
findings.replacement:
People who had stepped outside the Great Nation’s laws and drawn a boundary around their own world.

And yet they had willingly crossed that boundary and rushed into a deadly place full of danger.
findings.source:
대국의 법도를 벗어나 자신만의 울타리를 세운 자들.

그러나 기꺼이 그 울타리를 무너트리고, 숱한 위험이 도사린 사지(死地)로 달려와 준 이들.

findings.current: The boy stood in his sight, his eyes wet with tears. His back was still bent low, trembling faintly, as if he couldn’t bring himself to straighten up.
findings.defect: The draft omits why the boy stays bowed: he is hiding his tear-filled eyes.
findings.rationale: 눈을 감추기 위해 explicitly connects his continued bow to concealing his tears.
findings.replacement: He saw the boy still bowed low, trembling faintly. Tears had filled the boy’s eyes at some point, and he couldn’t bring himself to straighten up and show them.
findings.source: 언제부터인가 눈물에 젖어 버린 눈을 감추기 위해, 깊숙이 굽힌 허리를 펼 생각조차 못 한 채 그저 가늘게 떨고만 있는 아이가 그의 시선에 닿았다.

summary: Several consequential errors alter the injury, the prince’s pledge, and who authorizes the execution. Other findings concern omitted relationships and pragmatic cues.
